sources.citation: Quebec retailer listings, checked 2026-07-31 (claims: none stated / LCD only)

sharedMapEvidence: None, and none is claimed — there is no map. Grouped as 'no communications port of any kind', the same bucket the catalogue README reserves for passive gear.
gotchas: The Light models are the bottom of the Victron range and the retail listings state no comms capability at all; the LCD models add a local display only. Recorded so nobody researches them twice.

Tagged unverified because the evidence is the absence of a claim on a retail listing, not a vendor datasheet line reading 'no communication interface'. If one of these turns up on a wall, confirm by looking at the case for a port before writing it off.
